output.summary: A perennial herb native to western, central and southern Europe, northwestern Africa, southwestern Western Asia and Siberia, salad burnet has fern-like toothed leaves and crimson spherical flower clusters. Its young leaves, which taste mildly of cucumber, are used in salads, sauces, drinks and flavourings; older leaves become bitter.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves are used in salads, dressings, sauces, drinks and flavourings; older leaves tend to become bitter.
